verdict.rationale: Ramp's Treasury page says deposits in a Ramp Checking Account get FDIC insurance "up to tens of millions of dollars per depositor" via IntraFi's ICS service. ICS is a program that spreads deposits across a network of partner banks, so the core of the story (extended FDIC coverage beyond a single bank) is delivered as Ramp's own documented banking feature, with First Internet Bank of Indiana as the deposit provider. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the automatic sweep mechanics (how and when funds move, which partner banks, per-bank limits, opt-out), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond a single marketing-page claim.
